title: ObjectBrowser - Unity Reflection & Type Inspector
summary: Deep runtime and editor reflection inspector for Unity3D, exposing all properties, fields, methods, and complete base class inheritance hierarchies for any selected scene GameObject or project asset.
highlights: Real-time deep .NET reflection across selected scene GameObjects and project assets, inspecting active components, properties, and methods.
Comprehensive inheritance chain visualization tracing hierarchy back through UnityEngine.Object to System.Object.
Method signature inspection extracting complete ParameterInfo, return types, and member flags directly within a docked Unity EditorWindow.
